title: KinematicRepresentation
description: One kinematic representation of the enclosing mechanism. A mechanism may carry more than one representation simultaneously.

convention.description: The DH convention this parameter set follows.

parameters.description: The ordered DH parameter rows, one per joint in the chain.

space_frame.description: Id of the fixed space frame the screw axes are expressed in, if using a space-frame formulation.

body_frame.description: Id of the moving body frame the screw axes are expressed in, if using a body-frame formulation.

home_transform.description: The end-effector transform at the mechanism's zero (home) configuration.

joints.description: The ordered screw axes, one per joint in the chain.

joint.description: Id of the joint this screw axis describes.

screw_axis.description: [wx, wy, wz, vx, vy, vz] screw axis, expressed in the representation's space_frame (or body_frame, if that is used instead).

coordinates.description: The independent generalized coordinates describing this mechanism's configuration.

constraints.description: The constraints relating those coordinates, for a parallel or closed-chain mechanism with no single kinematic chain.
